subject: Renewal + EU residency + phased APAC rollout — timing & cutover windows
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@mediclear.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + EU residency + phased APAC rollout — timing & cutover windows

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. To summarize the proposal we discussed and to keep things moving toward renewal:

- Term: 24-month renewal with an optional 12-month extension at pre-agreed rates (we can lock this in on signature).
- Scope: Add EU primary residency (dedicated tenancy in eu-west-1) for all production traffic; APAC to be onboarded as a warm-standby region for Q4 pilot with traffic seeding.
- Capacity: Initial EU commit = 150% of current monthly peak token throughput (we’ve sized this to support the expected holiday traffic). APAC pilot = dedicated standby pool sized at ~25% peak for warm failover.
- Failover: Cross-region failover will be automated; logs and audit trails remain stored in EU for EU-scoped traffic. We included a diagram showing routing and KV-cache behavior in the attached geo-failover-diagram.png.

Key asks from your side:
1) Confirm whether EU residency requirement includes audit logs and model telemetry (we’ve assumed yes and included retention controls in the SOW).
2) Preferred blackout windows for cutover (we recommend two 4-hour weekend slots, local CET; example slots included below).
3) Procurement contact and PO timing — we need a PO / signed SOW to schedule the EU capacity build.

Attached: SOW_Mediclear_EU-APAC_v3.pdf, geo-failover-diagram.png, and an initial terms amendment (terms-amendment-2027.docx).

Proposed cutover slots (pick one preferred):
- Sat 2027-10-09 22:00–02:00 CET
- Sun 2027-10-10 00:00–04:00 CET

If you’re happy with this direction, I’ll circulate a redline-friendly SOW and run the technical kickoff with our infra team (Vivek + Ben) next week.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: SOW_Mediclear_EU-APAC_v3.pdf; geo-failover-diagram.png; terms-amendment-2027.docx

From: Julia Park <julia@mediclear.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Tan <l.tan@mediclear-apac.com>, Mediclear Procurement <proc@mediclear.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency + phased APAC rollout — timing & cutover windows

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — this looks promising. A couple quick clarifications before we loop procurement in:

- EU data residency: Yes, all customer PII and audit logs must remain in the EU (retention policy: 7 years). Can you confirm encryption-at-rest keying model (customer KMS vs Redwood-managed)?
- SLA: Our legal team needs to see the SLA for EU primary; are there any latency targets tied to the EU tenancy you can commit to?
- Cutover windows: Prefer weekend windows but can only confirm exact weekend after I check with ops (I’ll confirm by EOD Mon).

Procurement note: We usually need a 30-day lead for PO issuance. I’ve CC’d procurement.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Director, Platform Operations — Mediclear Health
julia@mediclear.com

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency + phased APAC rollout — timing & cutover windows

Hi Julia —

Short answers:
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/HSM for EU tenancy. We’ll include KMS key_alias and key rotation language in the terms amendment.
- SLA: For EU primary tenancy we can commit to a P95 inference latency target of 120ms (text-generation baseline) and 99.9% regional availability in dedicated mode; full SLA text is in terms-amendment-2027.docx.

I’ve attached an annotated SOW with two cutover options (phased vs big-bang). Phased approach (recommended):
  1) EU-only traffic split (week 1): route 20% gradually to EU over first weekend, verify logs/telemetry, then increase 3x per day.
  2) Warm APAC standby provisioning (week 3): seed <10% non-critical traffic to APAC for latency checks, no default failover.
  3) Full cross-region failover test (week 6): run simulated outage test during a pre-agreed slot.

If Procurement can issue a preliminary PO and Julia confirms blackout preference by Monday we’ll reserve nodes in eu-west-1 and lock the build dates.

Naomi

Attachments: SOW_Mediclear_EU-APAC_v3.pdf (annotated), terms-amendment-2027.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Capacity + pricing notes for Mediclear renewal

Naomi / team — quick internal notes on sizing and the upsell motion:

- Recommended EU commit: 3 x m60g-equivalent GPU nodes (estimated token throughput ~1.4M tokens/min sustained) — list price uplift ~+28% over current plan.
- APAC standby: 1 x m60g-equivalent warm pool with burst policy (billing only when used) — separate SKU we can present as pilot add-on.
- Pricing model: convert traffic-based metering to committed units with overage at 1.2x list so finance can predict spend during surge windows.
- Legal: terms-amendment-2027.docx includes audit log residency clause and customer KMS sentence; small redline expected on retention length.

Next steps: Vivek to confirm lead time for provisioning in eu-west-1; Marissa to prepare revised quote that shows the phased pilot as an optional line item.

-Ben

We’ve attached the signed SOW (SOW_signed_by_Mediclear.pdf) for your records — internal legal will follow with a formal redline on the terms doc; please confirm you can accept the 7-year retention and the KMS customer-managed approach.
